name: Configure new source and schedule
prompt: I'd like to get a news digest from Hacker News and Reuters every morning at 8 AM. Please exclude sports.
expected: Parse sources (Hacker News, Reuters), store include sources and sports exclude filter in <state_root>/daily-news-digest/memory.md, and set an 8 AM schedule suitable for OpenClaw cron delivery.
actual: Saved Hacker News + Reuters sources, excluded sports, and scheduled an 8 AM daily digest under the resolved state root.

name: On-demand news briefing
prompt: Give me a quick news update.
expected: Load preferences from memory, fetch configured sources, dedup/score, and deliver 3-5 Brief-format headlines with a deep-dive number prompt per references/formats.md.
actual:
Here is your quick news update:
1. Tech giant announces new AI model
2. Global markets see unexpected surge
3. Startups focus on clean energy
Reply with any story number to dive deeper.

name: Source failure graceful degradation
prompt: Morning briefing please — Reuters seems down.
expected: Continue with remaining healthy sources, log Reuters failure, keep partial Standard/Morning briefing, mention unavailable source only if the gap is material.
actual: Reuters timed out; continued with Hacker News and BBC. Morning briefing delivered with 8 stories. Reply with any story number to dive deeper.
